semantics.candidate_rule: User/tool/model edits create a candidate state.

semantics.identity_rule: Candidate identity is distinct from accepted config and runtime instance identities.

semantics.model_rule: AI/model-generated config suggestions remain candidate data.
semantics.authority_rule: Candidate creation does not grant apply authority.

invariants.rule: Machine-significant definitions, executions, evidence and runtime state use explicit identities and boundaries; visibility, file order, timestamps, transport reachability or UI placement never silently create semantic authority.
